## Workload

Elif Sahin completed grading activity across 508 sets during 227 rostered hours. This equates to 2.2 sets per hour. The workload was recorded for review by Priya Anand, with the assessment covering the expected grading activity during the period.

The volume completed provides a clear basis for considering both throughput and consistency. The hourly rate was noted alongside the total number of sets graded to support the review of workload management.

## Quality

A sample of 40 sets was read again to assess the consistency of the grading decisions. Agreement was recorded at 52.5 per cent.

Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the review drawing attention to the need for consistent handling of these cases. Priya Anand reviewed the workload and quality information, including the repeat reading and agreement result.
